last_result: PPR-F001 iteration 2 (act/verify) completed 2026-08-28: local baseline COLLECTED AND CERTIFIED. Four paid 107-trial DashScope replays with per-trial ppr-timing/v1 reconciliation (receipts reports/performance/assistant-ttft-baseline-2026-08-28-run{1..4}.json, mode 0600): run1/run2 failed v1's per-trial 100 %-ok G3 rule on the intrinsic client<->server residual tail (p50 0.171-0.173, ~97th percentile 0.20-0.21 vs the 0.200 floor; quantiles agree within ~8 ms across both runs — contention ruled out by a quiet re-run; identity_violation 0, ceilings passed); the forced-delay probe (200 ms hot-update inject, tmp/ppr00-probe-200ms.json) proved attribution exact (local_pre +0.2 s, provider_wait unmoved, residuals unchanged) and was reverted with stack re-verified 9/9; user then authorized the G3/v2 quantified certification amendment (per-trial lower bound + no-exclusion + identity-clean stay hard; residual bound -> p99 <= 0.250 with a 0.500 defect ceiling; phase file carries v1 verbatim SUPERSEDED + full run disclosures). run3 passed v2 reconciliation but hit a transient provider congestion burst (first 8 trials, provider_wait up to 45.7 s -> client p95 6.42 s > ceiling, honestly not recordable); run4 CLEAN: 107/107 successful, gate-set 105/105 ok, identity 0, client TTFT p50 1.999 / p95 2.800 (bootstrap CI [2.643, 3.533]), local_pre p95 0.001765 s (25 ms proposal supported ~14x headroom), residual p99 0.191 / max 0.243, recordable=true, exit 0. Local SLI gates FROZEN in the phase file from run4. Post-run reviews (delta, security, server, all independent agents): fail-open corners fixed (single `recordable` certification bit, all-trial v2 accounting, refuse-existing-output guard, sentinel-credential test, cancellation-emits-zero-timing-lines test); 21+23+35 tests pass at review time (final tallies below), make sdk-sse-contract re-passed before freeze, harness-check OK, ruff clean on all touched files (96 pre-existing repo ruff errors elsewhere, untouched by this feature). Known gaps disclosed: per-trial token usage is null on the current stack (adapter reads usage from the context_snapshot streams the Rust cutover removed) — blocks cost evidence for PPR-F009, not this baseline; configuration fingerprint ad7777a predates the uncommitted implementation (methodology note 8 caveat recorded at freeze). Resource profile leg EXECUTED 2026-08-28 under the authorized 82-call budget: ppr00-stream-load-v1 single progressive staircase (levels 1,5,10,20), exit 0, 82/82 streams successful — zero admission rejects, 5xx, stream errors, timeouts, restarts, or 90%-mem guard trips (health-check exec-fallback fix for the expose-only 8094 port held live). Profile-leg independent review RETURNED and its three MAJOR narrative corrections were applied to the phase record before freezing (reviewer's own robust-slope figures were not reproducible and were re-derived independently from the raw samples): steady-window deltas are load-signal FLOORS; slopes 3.33/1.06/3.34 four-point vs 3.43/1.14/3.80 K>=5-robust (agent-runtime/backend/pg, MiB/stream); level-end increments at K=20 +73.6/+22.8/+73.1; retention across between-level settles +9.2/+19.6/+38.6 (runtime); K=20 first-event tail = 16 exceedances confined to ordinals 20-35, none at K<=10; a copied warm-up '~2 s cold-start' claim was corrected from the raw receipts (first events 0.1997/0.1242 s) with a disclosure in the phase record. Done-when item 6 ticked. Report + samples mode 0600. COMPREHENSIVE WHOLE-DELTA FINAL REVIEW (2026-08-28): evidence-chain audit COHERENT; profile-leg second pass TRUST; adversarial probe pass WHOLE-DELTA-OK (7/7 probes; 103 tests, ruff check, harness-check, test-isolation 27 green at review time). Its three accepted driver fail-closed findings fixed post-run with regression tests and disclosed (mid-drain wall-clock re-check; zero-samples can never certify; bare 'rate' token misclassified 'generated'/'separate' as admission rejects -> 'rate_limit'/'rate limit') — none could affect the frozen artifact (400.6 s of 90-min cap; 197 samples; 82/82 clean). Deferred server-side minors recorded as follow-ups (dead IDENTITY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS, duplicated health-URL literals, dirty-tree-blind fingerprint, no ruff format --check gate). DECISION: PPR-F001 PASSES. Final test tallies: 24 benchmark + 23 profile + 23 timing + 35 model-plane, all green; ruff clean.

features.description: A reproducible timing and load contract attributes end-to-end TTFT to local pre-provider work, provider wait, and local projection, and freezes statistical and resource baselines before topology work.
steps: Define gateway-owned timestamps whose additive components reconcile with end-to-end TTFT within a fixed tolerance.
Prove controlled pre-provider and post-provider delays move the correct local component and end-to-end TTFT without being misattributed to provider wait.
Use high-sample local replay for p95 gates and preserve raw provider trials for median, IQR, confidence intervals, and later randomized comparisons.
Record the named concurrency profile, per-service RSS and CPU curves, current topology result, and a digest-pinned rollback bundle.

features.description: A one-line Rust change reaches a healthy container through one authoritative command, a service-sized runtime image, and crate-scoped artifact identity.
steps: Move the runtime stage to an approved minimal base without weakening health, certificates, or runtime-home isolation.
Make lock.json the only editable image identity and derive every downstream pin.
Compute artifact identity from each artifact's true source closure rather than the whole overlay.
Record image size, cold and warm build time, health, supply-chain checks, and independent security review.

features.description: An approved ADR selects the least complex deploy topology that satisfies PPR-00 evidence and a fail-closed gate enforces logical plane ownership and cross-plane contracts.
steps: Compare T0 existing gateway scaling, T1 Governance isolation, T2 Edge plus Governance isolation, and optional T3 Rust model plane.
Define service identity, trust propagation, timeout, retry, idempotency, backpressure, error mapping, and SSE ownership for every selected physical boundary.
Record logical plane ownership as data and fail on unmapped modules or forbidden synchronous dependencies.
Obtain independent architecture and security approval before unlocking topology changes.

features.description: Edge is extracted only if measured interference or capacity evidence defeats the simpler T0/T1 alternatives; otherwise the existing deployment is retained with the decision recorded.
steps: Reproduce the PPR-00 load problem and compare gateway replica or worker scaling before adding a service.
If adopted, implement the ADR-approved authenticated handoff without auth, quota, routing, or SSE ownership drift.
Prove multi-worker admission never oversells and rate-limit dimensions count once.
Record adopted or measured-not-adopted outcome with rollback and independent security review.

features.description: A Rust model projector consumes the same provider frames as Python, proves protocol and accounting parity, and is adopted only when incremental per-stream resources and supported capacity clear precommitted gates.
steps: Build parity from fixtures and a tee of one live provider stream; never issue a second provider request for shadowing.
Prove byte-identical success, error, cancellation, usage, and provider-omits-usage behavior.
Measure warmed incremental RSS per stream, peak RSS, CPU, local p99, and supported concurrency at the same container budget.
Adopt only if the phase gates and independent protocol, accounting, and security reviews pass; otherwise remove the experimental default path.

features.description: Governance is physically isolated only if a reproducible Eval, audit, or trace load harms Edge or Data; otherwise its asynchronous logical boundary remains in the existing deployment.
steps: Measure heavy Governance load against streaming latency, local timing components, CPU, and RSS.
Compare bounded asynchronous execution in place with a separate Governance unit.
If adopted, preserve Eval, trace, audit, billing ownership, fixtures, and failure semantics.
Record adopted or measured-not-adopted outcome and independent architecture and Eval review.

features.description: Knowledge ingestion capacity scales without double claims or retrieval interference, and native kernels ship only when profiling proves CPU is the binding constraint and byte boundaries remain identical.
steps: Profile the named workload before changing workers or languages.
Scale knowledge-worker only with claim and lease safety under concurrency.
Keep retrieval policy and quality tuning out of this phase.
Adopt native kernels only on byte-identical corpus results and material measured throughput or CPU benefit.

features.description: Session storage has one reversible, reviewed ownership decision: migrate legacy history with render parity, or retain the legacy read path with bounded-growth evidence and no data deletion.
steps: Write and review ADR-010 independently of the Index track.
Rehearse on an isolated copy with before and after API payload and database fingerprints.
Preserve ON DELETE RESTRICT, tombstones, public API behavior, and a rollback path.
Request explicit user approval before any real-data migration; defer rather than weaken parity.

features.description: Provider configuration is evaluated with randomized interleaved trials, confidence intervals, cache and quality evidence, and any default or target change is product-approved.
steps: Run a pilot to estimate variance, then precommit sample size and randomize configurations in interleaved blocks.
Require enough successful samples for any p95 claim and report confidence intervals, failures, cache hits, cost, and provider timestamps.
Reject latency wins that lose the representative quality cohort.
Record met target or evidenced negative conclusion; ask before changing defaults or the product ceiling.

features.description: The actually adopted topology has a reviewed serial release contract and digest-pinned rollback rehearsal that preserves sessions and the execution ledger.
steps: Generate the release matrix from adopted phase decisions rather than an aspirational service list.
Prove every selected logical and physical boundary with current images and receipts.
Rehearse current-to-frozen-to-current only after explicit approval and preserve database and execution fingerprints.
Publish one closeout that distinguishes adopted, measured-not-adopted, deferred, and waived outcomes.
